rules.completeResolution: Keep canonical daily food/water quantities, assessment and Rest Debt clocks. Endurance uses two separate0/1 cause counters to omit every first qualifying food/water-only daily penalty and sleep-debt penalty, applying every second. This is a NEW half-frequency exception, not a claim of literal doubled irregular deadlines. Safe rest and fully supported food/water days clear only their stated cause counter. Survivalist halves personal2lb/8pint to1lb/4pint; no oil, other logistics or rest reduction.

One480-active-minute feat forage completion per24elapsed hours, maximum14lb food/56pints water against real accessible stock. Insufficient stock requires a smaller predeclared supported amount or another actual ordinary procedure, not fictional resources. Containers, hazards, age, depletion, Large consumers and two-work-Watch cap remain. No seven complete Supply baskets or duplicated cooked/foraged inventory.

Adopt powerful ten-minute source Appraise with real current properties/reference value and protected-information exceptions. Haven’s thirty-minute appraisal and thirty-minute disposition remain complete: the feat’s examination/bargaining may be a genuine included subtask, not a second roll or shortened settlement. Predeclare legal success and actual fees; preserve claims, tax, sponsors, title, sale offers and the greater-of false-coin assessment with fees counted once.

Use completed EX58 physical mounting/dismounting, footprint, tack, burden and route rules. Cavalry+10 modifies existing mount Speeds once before normal limiting stages, not a new mode, vehicle speed, rider self-movement or second movement budget. Mounted Combatant remains melee/smaller-unmounted only; Cavalry retains source broader attacks against any unmounted size.

Adopt three finite real-animal chassis and their original-body conversion. A companion/mount body has one compatible elected controller/phase with spent budgets retained, no extra independent turn. Companion Training’s level10 two recipients do not grant a second offensive action. Leadership hires require real people/contracts and the owner-locked12-character cap; animals are actual separately classified roster bodies, not invented free characters.

Only an entire genuinely authorized repair of at most30active minutes can occur in the owner’s real beneficial short rest. A long reconstruction’s last30minutes does not qualify. Actual repair materials, primary bodies, currentHP caps, service/fuel/recharge and failure remain separate. Fortification/siege/kill-zone work requires actual structures and material, no free production or invented weaker target seam.

One actual beneficial-rest epoch governs allowances, recipient locks and refunds. Two beneficial short rests between beneficial long rests; one beneficial long rest/24hours. Debt-clearing rest alone adds no reward. Initial feat uses do not fill RP, heal capacity growth or remove old spent ledgers. Undying Flesh explicitly permits its no-Action choice while incapacitated solely by the triggering living0HP drop, not resurrection.

Actual class feat opportunity and permanent prerequisites remain. Six training snapshots are fixed at acquisition; Expertise replaces PB. Thievery/Disable Device map only their exact mechanical thieves’-tools scope; Spellcraft is not Arcana. Work discounts use their stated strongest factor or exact ritual composition, not calendar compression, a third work Watch or simultaneous incompatible work.

Keep predeclared achievable outcomes, real language/channel and paid time. The reviewed standing score remains−3..+3 with signed per-scene change capped±2; persuasion/feat names do not reset earned histories or generate another reward. Source-specific Deceiver truth-compulsion exception is adopted explicitly without compelling belief, consent or impossible action.

Adopt the proposed real-source60ft/24hour water-air passage impression with its actual check and known trail origin, and mapped-traversed-route guarantee within its exact recorded route. No teleport trail, hidden geography, arbitrary body source, oracle truth or general concurrent work credit follows.

Distinct eligible flat feat bonuses add after retained class/spell/item families. Same feat identity once; Expertise/advantage/resistance/critical range retain their own rules. Damage percentages independently floor the eligible native pre-save/pre-defense base and add without compounding. Hostile slows remain strongest, so Slasher−10+Crippling−10 is−10, not−20. Eight already reviewed feats/HP components unchanged.

The twelve Warrior standalone/counterpart pairs are one paid feat identity, with actual class-level/equipped/active requirements and no new slots/engine. Actual ancestry or an independently reviewed lineage receipt is required where printed; no Half-Elf/Half-Orc/Dragonborn/Sorcerer alias is silently created. Fixed training branches, owned uses and state history survive later temporary loss without replay.

Adopt separate paid Spell Focus, feat-only CHA Eldritch Blast and Detect Thoughts, finite16 curricula, seven explicit Ritual tags and specified copy/Time/nature profiles. No original335feat/848spell or class catalog insertion occurs. Paid copy casts preserve RP/components/history but create no copy/resource/class-proc chain; secondary echoes/redirects remain noncasts. Mage3max8 and Dragoon8max7 are actual capacity checks; Warrior7 has no RP.

Preserve both complete original spell-grant sources and finite wrappers with operational payload null and selection unavailable. No travel/binding target, plane/soul origin or cosmology effect is authored. Literal labels in other bounded mechanics remain receipts, not a reason to defer those otherwise complete feats.

The complete327 register answers every original question, retains660 original example positions with full corrected expectations, and gives finite shared/supplement/FEX directions. Build the complete candidate and return exact text/envelopes for a separate exact review. No generic preliminary conference remains for these supplied source questions; actual operation-specific prerequisites and two deferred payloads remain. No runtime, human balance or whole-game approval is granted.
